display_long_description:
Teach My Little Sister How To Drive Taxi 🚕

You're a taxi driver. You're also a driving instructor. Unfortunately, your student is your little sister. What could possibly go wrong?

Welcome to Teach My Little Sister How To Drive Taxi, a hilarious driving simulator where your mission is simple: teach your little sister how to become the best taxi driver in town!

There's just one tiny problem... she's watching EVERYTHING you do.

Every turn, every traffic light, every questionable parking decision, and every unfortunate accident could become part of her driving education.

🚕 Be the Best (or Worst) Driving Instructor!

Get behind the wheel of your taxi and show your little sister how it's done! Pick up passengers, navigate busy streets, and demonstrate your incredible driving skills.

Or don't. We're not here to judge.

🚦 Your Driving, Your Lessons!

Your little sister looks up to you and trusts you to teach her everything about driving. Will you show her how to respect traffic laws, drive responsibly, and keep passengers safe?

Or will you accidentally teach her that sidewalks are shortcuts and red lights are just suggestions?

😂 A Driving Lesson You'll Never Forget!

- Teach Your Little Sister: She's watching you drive, so make every lesson count!
- Become a Taxi Driver: Pick up passengers and take them to their destinations.
- Drive Your Way: Follow the traffic rules or become the reason they exist.
- Cause Hilarious Chaos: Sometimes the best driving lessons
